svg.title: Projection paradigms, dual projection transformer, regional partitioning, and region-guided expert transformer
svg.desc: Four horizontally arranged base frames. Frame f01 contains a 3D BEV grid, a left vertical feature plane, projected cuboids, and caption (a). Frame f02 contains a similar BEV/feature projection, depth-guided cuboids, a vehicle-like point/image sketch above, a recursive curved arrow, and caption (b). Frame f03 after a dashed separator contains a BEV grid, feature plane, colored regional light cones linked to expert icons, stacked blocks at right, and caption (c). Frame f04 contains a colored region cube, expert/router modules, a blue arrow to a recursive expert variant with black expert icon, cuboid stack, router, return arrow, and caption (d). Symmetry/equipartition basis: panels are laid out left-to-right on a common baseline with captions aligned; repeated icons and cuboids use regular spacing.

g.text: (d) Region-guided Expert Transformer and its recursive variant
